Actuals also higher overseas for New #DemonSlayer, which will join previous instalment #MugenTrain by THU as the only 2 anime films in history to cross hit 500M mark at Global #BoxOffice!

Apart from #Japan’s $222.2M (¥32.73B) cume, #DemonSlayerInfinityCastle aka #鬼滅の刃  」#無限城編 hits 178M intl. cume over other 62 markets overseas, which is already over 2x more than #MugenTrain grossed on its entire international run in 2020/2021.
